messages.content: Good evening Marcus. I am Captain Rob Harlow, currently deployed at sea. Your profile photo made me smile. You look like a trustworthy man.
ha, thanks I guess? do I know you? I mostly use this app for keyboard forums
Fate brought us together, my friend. Message me on Telegram, @rob_harlow_navy, because the ship network blocks this app.
maybe later, I'm at work. what ship are you on?
I can't say for security reasons. Marcus, I'm in trouble. My leave request needs a processing fee, and if I don't pay it the commander says I'll lose my posting or even be detained.
that sounds really odd. can't the navy just take it out of your pay?
Only Steam gift cards are accepted out here. Please buy $500 of Steam gift cards and send photos of the codes on Telegram tonight. You're the only person I trust.
